summary: Induction on s: each factor 1 − z_w adds at most dim ker(1 − z_w) ≤ dim/(N − 1) and multiplies the shortness bound by 4.

steps.claim: Induction on s (adding one prime w at a time), for all p.
steps.lean: induction' s using cons_induction with w s _ a generalizing p

steps.claim: s = ∅: T = 1, both claims are trivial.

steps.lean:
erw [card_cons, ramifyingOp, prod_cons, map_mul, map_sub, map_one, asAlgebraHom_of,
    p.comap_comp (D.ramifyingOp s)]
  use by grw [(a _).1, (by simpa [↓← finrank_eq_rank, ← Nat.cast_add] using
    (1 - D.centralRep (D.centralGen w)).lift_rank_comap_le :), Nat.cast_add,
    finrank_ker_one_sub_centralGen_le]; grind, by simpa [pow_succ', mul_assoc] using!
    ((a p).2 · · · |>.sub_translate (scalarFin_centralGen_mem ..).1)

erw [card_cons, ramifyingOp, prod_cons, map_mul, map_sub, map_one, asAlgebraHom_of,
    p.comap_comp (D.ramifyingOp s)]

steps.claim: dim (1 − z_w)⁻¹(q) ≤ dim q + dim ker(1 − z_w) ≤ dim q + dim/(N − 1) (`finrank_ker_one_sub_centralGen_le`), with the induction hypothesis; and (1 − z_w)ψ is 4·(4^{#s}B)-short (`IsShort.sub_translate`, z_w ∈ K_f).
steps.lean:

    finrank_ker_one_sub_centralGen_le]; grind, by simpa [pow_succ', mul_assoc] using!
